name: Coordinate-wise W2 window scan
source: Cheng et al., Optimal Transport Based Change Point Detection and Time Series Segment Clustering, arXiv:1911.01325
implementation: Adjacent-window coordinate-wise empirical W2; not the full Brownian-bridge W2T statistic.

name: Coordinate-wise W2 + matched filter
implementation: W2 window scan with triangular matched-filter post-processing (Cheng-style proxy).

name: Alias for coordinate_w2_window_scan
implementation: Deprecated alias; use coordinate_w2_window_scan or coordinate_w2_matched_filter.

name: Coordinate-wise W2T
source: Cheng et al., Optimal Transport Based Change Point Detection and Time Series Segment Clustering, arXiv:1911.01325
implementation: Reimplemented by averaging one-dimensional W2 scores over coordinates.

name: Sliced Wasserstein window scan
implementation: Custom random-projection implementation; POT can also provide OT utilities.

name: Sinkhorn window scan
implementation: Uses POT entropic OT when installed.

name: Bures-Wasserstein covariance scan
implementation: Implemented directly from the covariance closed form.

name: Covariance Frobenius-distance scan
implementation: Implemented as an adjacent-window Frobenius norm between sample covariance matrices.

name: PCA subspace-distance scan
implementation: Implemented as an adjacent-window projector distance between leading PCA subspaces.

name: WATCH-style initial-distribution monitor
source: Faber et al., WATCH: Wasserstein Change Point Detection for High-Dimensional Time Series Data, arXiv:2201.07125
implementation: Lightweight proxy: compare each rolling window to an initial reference distribution.
notes: Use the authors' code for exact WATCH replication when available.

name: PELT-L2
source: Killick, Fearnhead, Eckley (2012); ruptures PELT documentation
implementation: Uses ruptures Pelt(model='l2') when installed.

name: PELT-RBF
implementation: Uses ruptures Pelt(model='rbf') when installed.

name: PELT-normal
implementation: Uses ruptures Pelt(model='normal') when installed.

name: Binary Segmentation
implementation: Uses ruptures Binseg when installed.

name: Bottom-Up segmentation
implementation: Uses ruptures BottomUp when installed.

name: Window-based CPD
implementation: Implemented as a generic RBF-MMD window scan to avoid a hard ruptures dependency.

name: MMD window scan
source: Gretton et al., A Kernel Two-Sample Test, JMLR 2012
implementation: Implemented with an RBF kernel and median-bandwidth heuristic.

name: M-statistic / kernel CPD
source: Li, Xie, Dai, Song, M-Statistic for Kernel Change-Point Detection, NeurIPS 2015
implementation: Implemented as a local MMD statistic over adjacent windows.

name: Energy distance scan
source: Matteson and James, A Nonparametric Approach for Multiple Change Point Analysis of Multivariate Data, JASA 2014
implementation: Implemented as adjacent-window multivariate energy distance.

name: KS window scan
implementation: Implemented coordinate-wise with average statistic.

name: Cramer-von Mises window scan
implementation: Implemented coordinate-wise with average statistic.

name: Relative density-ratio CPD proxy
source: Liu, Yamada, Collier, Sugiyama, Change-Point Detection in Time-Series Data by Relative Density-Ratio Estimation, arXiv:1203.0453
implementation: Proxy implementation using logistic separability of adjacent windows.

name: CUSUM mean alarm
implementation: Implemented directly as two-sided standardized CUSUM.

name: CUSUM volatility alarm
source: Classic CUSUM applied to squared returns
implementation: Implemented directly on squared standardized observations.

name: EWMA volatility alarm
implementation: Implemented directly using EWMA variance innovations.

name: Bayesian Online Change Point Detection
source: Adams and MacKay, Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection, arXiv:0710.3742; dtolpin/bocd
implementation: Lightweight Gaussian predictive BOCPD implementation for univariate streams.

name: Gaussian HMM
implementation: Uses hmmlearn when installed.

name: Markov-switching regression/volatility
source: Hamilton, A New Approach to the Economic Analysis of Nonstationary Time Series and the Business Cycle, Econometrica 1989
implementation: Registered for experiment reporting; use statsmodels.tsa.regime_switching for full model fits.

name: Proposed: local alert only
implementation: Local Wasserstein alert only; see method/local_global_wasserstein.py.

name: Proposed: local + persistence proxy
implementation: Local alert with persistence filter; no global layer.

name: Proposed: local + global, no prototypes
implementation: Local alert + greedy global refinement without prototype posterior.

name: Proposed: local + prototypes, no global
implementation: Local alert + prototype posterior without global refinement.

name: Proposed: local + prototypes + global refinement
implementation: Full three-layer pipeline in method/local_global_wasserstein.py.

name: Alias for proposed_local_persistence_proxy
implementation: Deprecated alias.
